# Romania Pathfinding Visualizer

> Interactive visualiser for search algorithms on the Romania map (the classic AI
> textbook map): breadth-first, depth-first, uniform-cost, greedy best-first, A*
> and bidirectional variants, animated step by step, with a live side-by-side
> comparison table and a measured guide to the LP + ALT heuristic.

The whole app is one client-side page — there are no server routes and no
separate article URLs. The prose below is rendered in the Guide tab and is
present in the DOM whether or not that tab is open.

## Contents

- **Map view** — pick a start and goal city, choose an algorithm per lane, then
  play, step or scrub the search. Frontier, visited set, current node, the final
  path, a straight-line overlay and an h-value heatmap are drawn on the map.
  The two lanes can be merged into a single map with one colour per lane.
- **Comparison table** — 17 metrics per lane: step, current, visited, frontier,
  generated, peak memory, path, time, cost, hops, T(n), S(n), optimal, complete
  and landmark effect at 2 / 4 / 8 landmarks.
- **Guide tab** — UCS to A*, what a heuristic is, why the LP and ALT bounds are
  admissible, and the measured performance of every variant over all 380 ordered
  city pairs.
- **Two skins** — a modern UI (light / dark / Dungeons & Dragons / space themes)
  and a pixel-art game UI with day/night, reachable from the mode toggle.

## Key facts

- Graph: 20 cities, 380 ordered city pairs, edge costs from the assignment PDF
  only. No straight-line distances and no GPS coordinates are used.
- Heuristics: LP (an offline scipy/HiGHS linear program) and ALT (landmarks plus
  the triangle inequality), combined as h = max(h_LP, h_ALT).
- Measured: zero admissibility violations and zero wrong optimal costs across all
  380 pairs, cross-checked against an independent all-pairs Dijkstra /
  Floyd–Warshall oracle.
- Informedness (ratio of sums over the 380 pairs): LP 0.683, ALT lm8 0.985,
  combined 0.986. Expansions: UCS 4180, A* with the combined heuristic 1922.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/NukerDucker/rome-pathfinding)
- Measurements: `eval/independent-eval.ts` (run with `bun eval/independent-eval.ts`)
